content: Some side effects of this medication may include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, dizziness, difficulty sleeping, or a runny nose. These effects are generally mild and tend to resolve within a few days. This medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits to you outweigh the potential risks of side effects. Atovaquone may cause a mild rash, which is usually not serious. However, it can be difficult to distinguish this from a rare rash that may indicate a severe allergic reaction. Severe allergic reactions to this medication are rare. If you experience any unusual or concerning symptoms, contact your doctor immediately. Before taking atovaquone, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. Atovaquone may cause dizziness, and consuming alcohol or marijuana (cannabis) can increase this effect. Limit your intake of alcoholic beverages. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used if clearly needed. It is not known whether atovaquone passes into breast milk, so consult your doctor before breastfeeding. Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase your risk of serious side effects. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Some medications may reduce the levels of atovaquone in your body, potentially affecting its effectiveness. If someone has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and take your next dose at the regular time. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not freeze this product, as freezing reduces the amount of atovaquone your body can absorb, which may make it less effective. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that this product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
